blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—It was a good night individually for two Cebuano guards in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday, October 7, at the SM Mall of Asia Arena. The results, however, were different, as Jared Bahay delivered a solid performance for Ateneo de Manila University, while Reinhard Jumamoy also came through for National University. But while Jumamoy celebrated a convincing victory, Bahay and the Blue Eagles were left on the losing end of the 100th chapter of the UAAP’s biggest collegiate rivalry between the La Salle Green Archers.
